title: hotfix/slo-enforcer-connection-leak-fix
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Hotfix: Fix connection leak in SLO enforcer that caused regional failover chatter under sustained load. Improved connection lifecycle and added additional metrics and tests.
description: Motivation: During a recent load test and an on-call incident (SUP-441) we observed the SLO enforcer gradually leaking goroutine-backed connection objects when a remote region reported transient errors. The leak amplified headroom reduction and caused unnecessary regional failovers and load-shedding. This hotfix closes the leak, hardens the backoff/circuit-breaker transition, and adds an e2e test to prevent regressions. Changes: - Fix: ensure connections created by the regional caller are always closed on error paths and timeouts. - Fix: guard the enforcer's in-memory map with a short-lived context and explicit cancel to avoid stale references. - Improvement: smoother hysteresis when promoting a failing region to degraded, reducing thrashing between failover and recovery. - Observability: add conn_pool.active_count and conn_pool.closed_total metrics and a debug trace when a region transitions to failover. Testing: unit tests for connection lifecycle, integration test simulating intermittent region errors, and a new perf canary run. Checklist: - [x] Reproduce locally with load test template - [x] Add unit and integration tests - [x] CI green - [x] Run perf canary in staging - [x] Coordinate with on-call and roll out to release channel Notes: This description intentionally keeps technical details but avoids full diffs. See commits and files_changed for specifics.
